|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">ワンパは捕まえた獲物の手足を雪で固めて動けなくしておく。ホスの冷気を利用して獲物の動きを封じるのだ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Frozen feet.

'''Card text:'''
Target a character at a marker site. Draw destiny. If that site is under 'nighttime conditions,' add 2 to destiny. If total destiny > ability, the targeted character may not move until the end of this turn.

'''Lore:'''
A wampa packs snow around the limbs of captured prey to immobilize them. It uses Hoth's cold to stop the prey from moving.
